row:
I am Chiropractor Dr. Mo in Manchester, UK. I make videos about symptoms, stretches & exercises for common injuries and conditions. From lower back pain, sciatica, neck pain, headaches, migraine, shoulder pain to posture. I give you advice, home remedies and self massage techniques. If you have questions, please comment them on the videos, I do my best to respond to all comments. 

https://www.facebook.com/Dr.MoDC
https://www.drmo.co.uk/ 
health@drmo.co.uk
